title: JMoney's Ledger: The Numbers Guy Whose Numbers Haven't Cooperated (Yet)
body: Jordan, better known around the league as JMoney, arrived in the Buckaroo Football League's record books in 2026 with a team name that doubles as a mission statement: Counting or not Counting GV. He doesn't claim to be a football savant. He's here for the math, and in a league full of Chicago guys yelling about gut feelings, that alone made him a curiosity. The spreadsheet, unfortunately, has been brutally honest so far.

The 2026 campaign opened with a thud: 76 points against Randy in week 1, still the low-water mark of JMoney's career. From there it became a tour of the league's front offices, with losses to Sonny, Alan the resident villain, Mekhi, and Kaushal piling up into a 1-5 record. Through six games he has put up 561.6 points, which works out to roughly 93.6 a week. That's respectable enough to suggest bad luck has played a part, and low enough to explain the record. Philliberto beating him is the kind of thing that happens when the bad guy wins, and JMoney has been on the wrong end of that script.

Then came week 5, the one bright line on the chart. JMoney dropped a career-best 119.7 on Zoe's Ghostu-Spider SZN, his only win and his first real headline. Beating Zilgit in her rookie season is a result he'll be reminded of at home, for better or worse, and it leaves him 1-0 in what may become the league's most awkward rivalry. Against everyone else he's 0-5. Against Z Squared he's perfect.

As a manager, JMoney is an active bookkeeper rather than a passive one. He's logged 7 waiver pickups and 1 trade, which already makes him more of a dealmaker than Randy will ever be. Whether those moves have balanced the books is a question for the second half of the season. The band-kid instinct to keep marching through a rough first half is at least serving him well.

As things stand, Counting or not Counting GV sits at 1-5 with title odds of 0 percent, a number even JMoney can't massage. The season is still in progress, though, and a spoiler run is very much available: Brucie and No Banner only HULK are still waiting on the schedule, and nothing would make the league happier than the numbers guy upsetting the best team in it. The ledger is open, and so far it shows one great day and a lot of red ink.
